title: Corrections of an elliptic block in the NS sector
summary: We propose a correction to one of the elliptic blocks in the NS sector of 2d $\mathcal N = 1$ superconformal field theories. We analyze the 4-point block in the pillow geometry to demonstrate the necessity of the correction and verify the formula by numerically checking the crossing symmetries in the $\mathcal N =1 $ super Liouville theory, as well as directly comparing the $c$-recursion and $h$-recursion results.
